intention: One nightly poller log shows every database call the cycle makes, in every module it touches, and the same cycle can be stepped through in the VS Code debugger.
request: MAG-57 Nightly Job Tests. The ticket asks questions about the nightly cycle, not a change. Every question was answered from the code and posted to Linear. The user then chose the scope: add query logging to analytics and charging (mirroring internal/telemetry/query_log.go), add a VS Code launch config for cmd/poller --once, and fix the misleading gap-reconciliation log line placement in internal/app/processor.go.

decisions.decision: No unit tests in any RM62 tier
decisions.why: Work is logging decorators plus a launch config. The telemetry precedent uses a compile-time assertion, so a missed method is a build error.

decisions.decision: Label both halves of recalculateAnalytics per vehicle
decisions.why: The single pre-loop window line reads as if it owns the Reconcile queries that follow it. Per-vehicle labels put every query under its own step.

decisions.decision: Tier order app then analytics then charging
decisions.why: No technical dependency between tiers. User wants the VS Code debug setup first so they can step through the poller while the logging tiers are written.

decisions.decision: Mirror internal/telemetry/query_log.go in both logging tiers
decisions.why: It is the only query-logging precedent in the repo. Explicit interface implementation, never embedding, so a new interface method becomes a compile error, not a silent unlogged call.
